essays.title: Building AI Agents That Handle CAPTCHAs: Lessons from the Frontline
essays.excerpt: Getting past CAPTCHAs is the single biggest bottleneck for AI agents browsing the web.
essays.body:
AI agents can browse websites, fill forms, and perform tasks. But the real challenge isn't getting an agent to click a button. It's making that interaction reliable, secure, and authorized.

Related Questions

How do AI agents handle CAPTCHAs?
AI agents use human-in-the-loop checkpoints, session continuity, and site-specific adaptations to gracefully handle CAPTCHAs rather than trying to bypass them.
What's the best edge device for computer vision?
NVIDIA Jetson Nano ($199) offers the best balance of performance and price, capable of 22 FPS with INT8-quantized YOLOv8.
Is OWASP relevant for AI projects?
Yes - AI agents need input validation, output sanitization, session management, and authorization checks at every step, similar to traditional web app security.
